About

From artifacts to interfaces.

Location
Vienna, AT
Status
Open to EU roles
Tools
Figma, Framer, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, FigJam, Miro, Microsoft Office.
Languages
English, Turkish

I studied prehistoric archaeology, which sounds far from product design until you ask the same question: how do humans shape the things they use, and how do those things shape them back.

Watching how early settlements evolved through design, necessity, and aesthetics taught me to look at tools as social objects. Pixels are softer than flint, but the questions are the same.

I care about small, quiet interactions. The kind you don't notice until they're gone.
